en: Hwaaaaaaaaaaaaaah...\nHaaaaaaaaaaaaah!
How on earth... how did\nsomething like this...!
Hwaaaaaaaaaaa...\nHieeeeeeeeeee!
Is this really the satellite\nMastima...?
According to the scans, there\nshouldn't have been any signs\nof life or civilization at all...!
Uoooooooooh... Guoooooooooh!
There shouldn't be any records\nof a structure like this on\nDaftes either...
Uguooooooooooooh...\nGaaaaaaaaaaaaah!
...Euwin, make sure you keep a\nfirm grip on Welch.
If she starts rampaging here, it\nlooks like no one will be able to\nstop her.
L-Leave it to me! Even if it\ncosts me my life...!
Let me go... Show me...! Show\nme something I've never seen\nbefore...!
...What on earth is wrong with\nthis person...?
Hehe... Everyone is exactly the\nsame. It makes me kind of\nhappy.
Yes. I know that for the\nCaptain and the others, it was\nonly a fleeting moment.
But for me... well. It was a\nmoment I had been waiting for\nfor so long.
...Still, I can hardly believe it.\nThat you would appear looking\nlike this, Tika...

I couldn't believe it at first,
either. To travel back through
time twice... in such a short
span of time.
So that's how it was, after all.

Tika, you jumped even further
into the past from that
moment when we were fighting
at Asyl.
Just how much...
Eight years, I think.
T-That much...?!
But as you can see, I'm doing\njust fine.

A lot happened, but I knew... I
knew for certain that I would
see everyone again, that we
would meet once more.
You knew...?
Yeah. Oh, look, over there!

Waaaaaaaah!! Th-the Royal
Capital's Crest Windmill... it's
not a dream... it's not a
dream...!
Why... was I unable to scan a\nstructure of this magnitude...?
That is where the master of\nthis planet resides... the Crest\nMuseum, Ex Giva.
Welcome, children of another\nstar.
I am Mastima, a failed\nGemologist cast out from\nParadise.
I also happen to serve as the\ndirector of this Emblem\nMuseum, Ex Giva.
Mastima...? That's the same\nname as the moon...
It is not that I share a name\nwith this satellite.
It is that my name was\nbestowed upon this satellite.
That is an important\ndistinction.
Cast out from Paradise... what\nis the meaning of that?
Hmm. Young scientist of\nLevarance, do you not know\nthe traces of Paradise?

However... you Earthling over
there. And you, puppet... I
suspect you might understand
what I mean.
Hehehe, you look surprised.\nThat is a good look for you.
...By puppet, do you mean\nyourself, Master Mastima?
If you lack that awareness,\nthen you are truly fortunate.

...I can sense malice from you,
Master Mastima, directed
toward both myself and my
origins.

However, more than the true
nature of that malice, I demand
an explanation regarding your
genetic information.
Your genetic information is\nfrom my home, EnII...
I see no meaning in answering\nyour question.

Did you think that playing the
role of the Universe's Guardian
would grant you everything you
desire?
W-What!?

It is about time you realized
that there are some things in
this universe that are better
left unknown.

Why don't you stop dancing to
Vandione's legacy and try
acting on your own will for
once?

If you intend to insult that
name, then consider it a
declaration of war against us
Morphus...!
Good grief. Even that\nstubbornness is exactly like\nVandione and that "Ex" of hers.
We're getting nowhere. Just\nstay quiet.
What...!! You...!
Valka, restrain yourself.
Let me go, Henri! She is...!
It seems she knows you, but\nwe know nothing about her.

This is her territory. I don't
think it would be in our best
interest to make an enemy of
her here.
Ugh...

Even so, Mastima. Using your
informational advantage to
unilaterally berate us is hardly
commendable.

Heh heh heh, my apologies, my
apologies. I suppose catching
the scent of my homeland just
makes me a bit restless.
Servant of Ex. I apologize for\nmy rudeness.
Oh dear, it seems I've been\nhated. Heh heh heh.
...Mastima. It seems you are\nquite well-versed in the affairs\nof the universe.
Well, I suppose so. I take pride\nin being one of the top one or\ntwo experts in the cosmos.
...It seems your will and power\nare heavily involved in the\nreason we are here.
Since we have been invited, I\nassume you will answer our\nquestions?

Very well. Despite
appearances, I am quite
interested in you all as well.
Ask me anything.
Now then, what is it you wish\nto know?
This celestial body is what you\nDaftine people call the Moon.
No, that's not what I meant.
Is there a reason why it shares\nthe same name as you?
There is no particular reason.

Long ago, when I descended to
Daftine, your ancestors―then
building a primitive
civilization―asked me my name.
They also asked where I came\nfrom, so I simply answered that\nI came from the Moon.
Could that be why?

Wait. The name Mastima has
been in literature for centuries,
dating back to the records of
the Holy Land War.
Just how old are you?
Is that such a surprise, young\nlady of the Foxtail?

Judging by the number of your
tails, you must have lived
through quite a few years
yourself, shouldn't you?
Eh? Is that so?

While individual variations exist,
a Foxtail grows a new tail
every fifty to a hundred years
at most.
Wha... A hundred years!?
...What?
...One, two... three...
Hey, wait a minute!
...I'm... sorry. For being so\ncheeky. Um, please forgive my\nrudeness to my elders.
That's even more annoying, so\nstop it!

It hasn't even taken me a
hundred years to grow a new
tail! Even at my longest, it's
only been 80 years...
...I'm really, truly sorry.
Welch!! I told you to stop!
Fufufu, well, that's just how it\nis. Everyone has their own\nreasons for their longevity.

Even I have lived for 3.7 billion
years since birth. I've at least
become worthy of having a
moon named after me.
Welch & Karlyn: ...Huh?
Hmm, I see. So Earth already\nhas those records.
Are you referring to the\n"Paradise" you mentioned\nearlier?
Captain, that's impossible. I... I\nsimply cannot believe such a\nthing.
You don't have to believe me,\nbut why can you say so\ndefinitively?
Do you think that only your\nVandione and Ex are special?
How vast a universe and how\nmany humans do you think\nParadise possessed?
Wait, Ex never said anything of\nthe sort...

Even one who knows
everything does not reveal
everything. At least, that is
what Vandione said.
I'll give you a warning. I don't\nknow how his descendants\ninteracted with Ex,
But if you fight blindly believing\nonly in them... your lifespan as\na warrior will not be long.
...Valka.
I shall tell those who do not\nknow.
Once, there was a planet called\nNede that ruled seventy\npercent of the galaxy.
I was born at the end of that\nhistory... and was chosen as\none to follow those ten.
That is correct. The "Ten Wise\nMen of God."
You've certainly been studying.
The ten individuals selected for\nthe First Ten Wise Men\nDefense Project...
Aside from Gabriel, before the\nfinal adjustments,
Zaphkiel, Jophiel, Metatron,\nSadikiel, Chamuel,
Raphael, Michael, Haniel, and\nLucifer―the nine of them were\ndeployed without issue.

Having evaluated their utility,
the Nede Defense Force began
preparations for the Second
Ten Wise Men Defense Project.
If they had continued to fight\nfor the defense of Nede just\nas they were...

Or if those fools in the Nede
army had been a little more
cautious... then perhaps I, too,
would have...

But well, after everything that
happened and after they went
mad, I was suspected of being
part of their madness,
And after fleeing and being\ncaptured, I finally arrived in\nthis star system.
Though I didn't take this form\nback then.
That was 3.7 billion years ago.
<font color=blue>Henri</font> Why couldn't the Captain\nor Valka's ship scanners\ndetect this Ex Giva?
<font color=blue>Mastima</font> It's obvious.

The concealment provided by
my Crest Arts is so superior
that your ship's scanners
stand no chance against it.

<font color=blue>Verda</font> Then, does that mean
those unidentified attacks on
the Levarance fleet and
Valka's ship were also...?
<font color=blue>Mastima</font> You all need to hone\nyour skills much more.
You can't even overcome a\nCrest created by a\n3.7-billion-year-old elder.
Even the OS of the computers\nyou use is still <font color=yellow>Lastia</font>, just like\nit was in the old days.
<font color=blue>Valka</font> <font color=yellow>OS Lastia</font>... Impossible...\nIt shouldn't even exist in this\nuniverse anymore.
<font color=blue>Mastima</font> ...I'm starting to feel a\nlittle sorry for you.

Based on what I know, there
are at least three other
computers equipped with
Lastia besides this Ex Giva.
<font color=blue>Valka</font> N-No way...!

At any rate, this Crest
Museum, Ex Giva, continues to
expand infinitely to satisfy my
Academic Thirst.

It is a hall of Gems from my
snowy homeland, dedicated to
exploring the truths of the
universe.

A tower that carves the truths
of the universe, which even my
entire life has not been enough
to fully unravel.
A tower that exposes the\ntruths of the universe.

A magnificent "waste," for it
cannot be completed simply by
cramming in my wisdom, and
thus, it lives on.
A waste?
A waste.
And that is exactly how it\nshould be.

My desire to research the
concept of Gems to its
absolute limit is why I could not
become one of the Ten Wise
Men.
To begin with, Tika, how\nexactly did you end up here on\nthe Ex Giva?

While the Captain fought at
Asyl, Rekoro, Coro, and I were
caught in the Moonshadow
Ladder and sent back to the
past.
We were cast out onto this\nsatellite, and Mastima\nprotected us immediately.
That was eight years ago.
It was a stimulating event, even\nafter all this time.

Even for me, it's the first time
I've heard of someone traveling
back in time twice in a row
without using a Time Gate.
On the Ex Giva, it's not just\nbecause of the Moonshadow\nLadder...

There are many people who
became lost in space for
various reasons that Mastima
has protected.
I was just like them, and\nMastima helped me so much.
She gave me anything I\ndesired.
That's why I asked her.
I asked for the power to fight!
...Damn it.
Hmm?
Look! Big sister Verda!
Oh!? Is that... a gun?
I thought that if I was going to\nget the power to fight, I\ndefinitely wanted a gun!
Because I've always looked up\nto you, Verda!
Nyah!?
...N-no way... To think you look\nup to me...
Oh, Tika...
Y-yeah. It's the first time I've\never seen Verda acting so\nfidgety.

I'm not going to stay behind
anymore! I can fight alongside
the Captain and Big sister
Verda and the others.
So, let's make sure we save\nBig sister Eve together!
Nyahuhu... kufufu...
And? General Ricardo. What\nexactly is your relationship to\nthis place and to her?

You still haven't thanked me
for the collar you gave me,
have you? Did you get that
here as well?

Come to think of it, you've
been searching for Tika this
whole time. Spending a massive
amount of money, too.

Since you were involved with
Mastima, does that mean, well,
you knew about Tika's situation
with time travel or something?
...Guh!
...Hey, it's time to tell the truth.

If it's hard to say, I'll do it!
Either way, once the armor and
mask are off, Valka will figure it
out immediately.
...Do as you wish.

...Ricardo Franz is a fake name
used to deceive the "me" from
my childhood, when I was with
Verda and the others.

Since it's the name of a
famous historical figure, my
younger self never suspected
a thing.
But my real name is...
Ricardo Blanche.
He is my real brother.
Whaaaaaaaaaaat!?
No, no, no, hold on, you're\nsaying that's him?
Tika, dear, you never once\nmentioned you had a brother...
Hmm? No? You did say...

You did say it, didn't you!?
Asking if you could get in
touch with your brother... Could
it be...!
I'm sorry for the confusion. Big\nbrother Ricardo and I are...
Ri... Ricardo... big brother...
Hey, witch! You got a problem\nwith that!!

I'm sorry. It's just, seeing a
glimpse into someone else's
family matters... it's a bit hard
to put into words.
Gah...!
Hehe. My brother and I have a\nten-year age difference.

By the time I immigrated with
our parents, my brother had
already become independent
and joined the military.
He was on a warship escorting\nthe immigration ship that\nRekoro and I were on.

So that is why you were asking
not if your brother was safe,
but why you couldn't get in
touch with him.
...I was sent to the past at the\nsame time as you, Tika.

I was protected by Mastima at
a point eight years even
further in the past than when
you guys arrived at Daftine.
...In other words, is this what\nhappened?

By the time you first met us,
Ricardo, you had already met
Tika, who had been sent to the
past during the battle at Asyl.
That's exactly right.

That's why when I met my
brother in the Rubarika forest,
he was eight years older than
the brother I knew.
On top of that, since he was\nwearing that mask, I couldn't\ntell who it really was...

It would indeed be difficult if
one did not already know that
they were being sent into the
past.

B-But despite that, you were
being pretty aggressive about
trying to take Tika away from
us, weren't you?

Precisely. As expected of
someone who truly
understands the logic of
traversing space-time.
Hehe, you see, my brother met\nme eight years ago... right?
Shut up!

He was desperately trying to
change the future so that I
wouldn't have to go through
such a terrible time!
Huh?
Well, all of that was a futile\neffort, though.
...You bastards...
...It's fine. I think I understand\nthat feeling a little.
Even in this short time, it's\nclear that you two were close\nsiblings to begin with.
Ehehe.
You're right. Well, as someone\nwho's been blackmailed quite a\nbit, I have my complaints, but...

I can certainly understand the
feeling of not wanting to put
your loved ones through
hardship.
...Don't act like you understand.\nIt makes me sick.
...You really are a piece of\nwork.
I see...
Ugh...
Verda?
Ah, sorry. Perhaps I'm just\nfeeling a bit tired.
But I'm fine now! I still have so\nmany things I want to ask\nMastima!
Verda...

Mastima. We've been fighting
non-stop since we boarded
Asyl. Can we take a break here
for a moment?

Very well. If you wish, why not
focus on your treatment
aboard those reborn ships of
theirs?
Reborn ships!?
That's right! If Tika is safe,\nthen Coro and Rekoro must be\nsafe too. Where are they!?
Of course they are! Let's go to\nCoro first!
Coro said he had a lot of\nthings he wanted to tell\neveryone, too.
Both Coro and the ship have\nbecome incredibly strong, even\nmore so than the Ex Giva!
Why the long faces? In eight\nyears, your ship has been\ncompletely reborn.
I guarantee it will be useful for\nyour future travels through\nspace.
...Easy for you to say.
...They say nothing comes for\nfree... I am uneasy.
Hehehe. Well then, shall we\nmove?
This is... a Transfer Gem!?
Space really is a lawless place,\nisn't it?
It certainly is! We're on the\nBridge. It looks like we really\nare safe!
Coro? Coro, where are you?\nCoroooo?
Oh! Coro!
...Confirmed boarding of Verda\nKleiman, crew of GFSS-3214F.
...Coro?
Ewin Laxter, Welch Vineyard,\nKarlyn Kayson, Valka S90,
Henri Anle Henri, Tika Blanche,\nRicardo Blanche, Mastima\nconfirmed boarding...
And,
Captain.
Captain... Captain,\nCAPTAIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIN!!!!
Hieee!?
I also included a runaway\nsuppression device as a bonus.
Now that's more like it, Coro. I\nwas starting to lose faith in\nyou.
Ahhh! I've been longing for\nthose insults!
You truly are incorrigible.
Actually... there are several\nthings I need to apologize to\neveryone for.
...It's kind of creepy when you\nsuddenly get all pious like this.
...Especially to you, Valka.
To me?
Yes... the truth is...
...Well, having come this far, I\ncould have guessed as much.

To protect Lady Tika after she
was sent to Daftes, I would
have had to be at Daftes
myself, wouldn't I?
Does that mean you're the one\nwho repelled Levarance's fleet\nfrom Eldram as well...?
Yes... it was me.

Since I could maneuver without
Mastima's stealth equipment
being detected at all, it was
easy.
Most of the other things were\nalso done by me.
Dropping Ms. Welch's lab to\nthat position,

It was all part of my plan to
ensure I could rendezvous with
everyone here at this very
moment.
...It's okay. I'm not angry.
Because thanks to you, I was\nable to meet my precious\nfriends.
That power of yours has saved\nus as well.
Once again, my heartfelt\nthanks to you, Coro.
Uuuh...! Valka... Henri...!
I agree with Henri. So...

I'll never forget that I fell to
Daftes not because of poor
maintenance, but because Coro
shot me down.
Eh?

I won't forget that it wasn't
poor maintenance, but that
Coro was the one who brought
me down.
...You're still holding a grudge,\naren't you...?
To me, it feels like it only\nhappened the other day.
*Sigh*... Careful what you say,\nthey say...
Ah... well, um, listen! Did\nMastima handle all the\nmodifications?
Not just myself, but everyone\nin the universe protected by\nEx Giva cooperated.

Rest assured, everything is on
a completely different level
compared to when you were
piloting them.
With that power... there is\nsomething I must ask of you.
...Well, I didn't think you'd go to\nall this trouble for us for\nnothing...
Just what do you want us to\ndo?
Many things.
Many things?!

Even so, I believe I have
provided the best possible
care for Tika, Coro, and the
others.

I want something in return, but
I believe my demands shouldn't
deviate too much from your
own objectives.

Well, you must be uneasy.
There is likely still much you
wish to know, and much I wish
to tell you.
But let us set that aside for\nnow.
You have been forced to suffer\nat the hands of that Givel\nmany times, haven't you?
In such a state, you would be\ntoo anxious to rescue your\nabducted comrades.
That is why I am calling on you.\nTika.
Yes... Captain, everyone. After\nwe get some rest...
Why don't we all level up\ntogether?
...Level up?
Tika. Ricardo. It seems you\nhave successfully reunited with\neveryone.

Hyaaaaaaah! What is that?!
What is that!! There's
something that looks just like
Valka out there!?
No... that is a fully autonomous\nmobile armament... a robot\nsoldier.
But it possesses an incredible\namount of Gem power...
Welch Vineyard. That reaction\nbrings back many memories.
Huh?

My functions have improved
greatly over these past eight
years, but my voice frequency
should remain unchanged.
...Wait a second. That sound...\nthat voice... could it be...?
Is it Rekoro?
Eh!?
What!?
Rekoro, you sayooo!?

Affirmative. I am Rekoro,
formerly the life-saving boat AI
aboard the transport ship
Kugo.
Y-you look quite different now...
Hmm? My exterior should not\nhave changed significantly.
Ah, a familiar sight.

Th-then what's with this "robot"
thing?! Is it something I'm
allowed to take apart for
research?!
No, that's definitely not\nallowed.

This robot is a modified
"Lambda" body, the
general-purpose AI weapon of
Ex Giva, repurposed for
Rekoro.

Equipped with Verda Kleiman's
Arms, they assist in Daftine,
combat training, security, and
even daily chores like cooking
and cleaning.
I oversee and operate a total\nof four "Lambda" units for\nTika's sake!
...My, you certainly cover a\nwide variety of tasks.
Ever since Rekoro came to Ex\nGiva, she's been supporting my\nlife constantly.
I understand Tika's vitals\nbetter than anyone else.

And if Tika intends to train
herself under the protection of
Mastima, it is my duty to
support that endeavor.
But I really wish she'd stop\ntrying to make me sleep with a\nLambda every night...
Ooh, ooh! What's that?! That's\nlike a servant doll or a maid\ndoll, right?!
To call them servants or maids,\ntheir appearance is... well,\nnever mind...

Does that mean Rekoro, too,
will be using the Lambdas to
participate in combat from now
on?

Negative. Due to my
personality program's
structure, I cannot participate
in combat, even using a
Lambda body.
As a life-saving AI, my\nprogramming does not account\nfor the act of harming others.
and if I were to change that, I\nwould no longer be myself.

Therefore, my training with
Tika is based on sports
science to develop her mind
and body, not an act of
combat itself.

Furthermore, the program that
operates these Lambda bodies
can only be maintained by the
Ex Giva's computer.
Once we reunite with the\nCaptain and return to the\nGFSS-3214F, then...
So you'll just be operating as\nRekoro alone, like usual.
That is correct.

However, as long as I have the
Lambda body, I can perform at
my full potential even in
defensive maneuvers.

I cannot strike back against
enemy attacks, but I promise
you this: I will protect Tika, my
charge, at all costs.
You're as overprotective as\never, aren't you?
That's also one of the good\nthings about this AI.
If you wish, I can also assist\nwith the Captain and the\nothers' combat training.

While not as much as Tika, I
can use the vital data I share
with Coro to help you all
improve yourselves here as
much as you desire.

The Galactic Federation's
Battle Simulator isn't bad, but
our simulator is on a
completely different level.
When set to No Mercy mode,\npeople die as if it were the\nmost natural thing in the world.
Hey, they're not supposed to\ndie...!
I can't tell you how many times\nI've had to step in and stop it...
Are you serious?

If you're using the simulator,
use Colony Rapture Day to
rest instead of returning to the
ship.
A colony?
This Ex Giva is divided into five\nsectors, each tailored to a\nspecific purpose.

Centered around Cosmo City,
where those protected by
Mastima reside, and Grand
Daft, which sits above it,

The remaining sectors are
divided into Rapture Day,
Deese, and Grand Meteora,
according to their objectives.
So, that many people are living\nthere.
That is correct. Well, there\naren't many places you all will\nneed to enter or exit.
We certainly do not have much\ntime to spare,

But even so, for both your
sake and mine... heal your
bodies thoroughly, and then
train.
Wait, Master Mastima! There's\nstill something I want to ask...!
The rest of the story can wait\nuntil you are more prepared.
For now, let Rekoro train you.\nFarewell.
...W-What is her problem?!
...Well, you'll get used to it\nsoon. That's just how she is;\nshe doesn't mean any harm.
I still haven't gotten used to it,\nthough.
I don't feel like I'll ever get\nused to her!

Even so, there is no doubt that
Mastima has sincerely
protected and guided you and
Tika. I want you to believe that.
...True. If she's going to be an\nally, it's not wise to oppose\nher.
I suppose I'll take her up on\nher offer for a little while.

Captain, Mastima and Coro are
calling for you. It seems there
has been some movement on
Daftine.
If you are in good condition, I\nwould like you to move to the\nBridge of GFSS-3214F.

Well, they aren't exactly
considering our feelings over
there, are they? Let's answer
the summons.
Hmm. Then let us go.
<font color=blue>Coro</font> I have been waiting! I\nhave discovered Eve's location!
<font color=blue>Verda</font> Is that true?!
<font color=blue>Coro</font> Yes. I tracked a\nteleportation signature that\nappeared to be Giverese,

After searching the Imperial
Capital, I found she had
returned to the Baschen
Imperial Castle―carelessly, or
perhaps quite normally.

<font color=blue>Verda</font> In other words, to save
Eve, we must infiltrate the
Baschen Imperial Capital once
again.

<font color=blue>Euwin</font> They couldn't contain
her last time, so I guess we
have to sneak into the Imperial
Castle again.
<font color=blue>Coro</font> No! Please do not worry!

With the modifications
Mastima-san gave me, there is
no place on Daftine I cannot
reach.

Whether it's Rubarika's
dungeons, Asyl at the sea's
bottom, or the Baschen
Imperial Castle, I can teleport
drop anywhere.

However, the Imperial Capital
remains on high alert, so we
should expect significant
resistance.
Since only Giverese, Elaine, and\nTika boarded Asyl...
It doesn't seem like there's a\nconsensus on who actually\nsecured the Holy Land.

As a result, the front lines
between Rubarika and Baschen
remain stable, just as they
were before the final battle.
Without order, the front lines\nwill stay in combat. It's the\nworst-case scenario.

There's even a risk that
Rubarika will suspect us of
assassination, sparking a war
of revenge.
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> It's even worse than\nthat; Emperor Baschen is\ncurrently absent.

Rubarika might take advantage
of the Crown Prince being left
alone to launch an invasion and
attempt to destroy Baschen...
<font color=blue>Welch</font> W-what are we\nsupposed to do?! It's not like\nwe can just not save Eve!
That's where I come in!
Whoa!?

For the Holy Land War's end
and a peaceful future for Tika
and the others, please hear my
proposal.
...Mastima. Why are you sitting\nso boldly in the Captain's\nseat?

Now, now, don't sweat the
small stuff. This is a deal that
benefits the people of Daftine
as well.
Hey.
